news.text: #Juve, #KoloMuani Risks Being DroppedTomorrow against #Genoa#Spalletti could make him sit out Marassi in an attempt to shake him up. [Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#WOLTE OVERTAKES #KOLOThe attacking hierarchy at #Juve could change: the Frenchman, who is struggling, risks being left out against #Genoa. And #Balogun in January...Moving forward with the 3-5-2 until the international break: the choice to play the German, with #Alajbegović in support, would also be revitalizing #Muani ahead of the #Napoli match. Meanwhile, the American puts himself forward again, with #Sørloth in the background. #Wiafe between the bianconero and... the Azzurro.[Front Page TuttoSport]

On that side, you never see a sign of life and the problem must be resolved. The shortcoming existed and continues to exist: it needs to be seriously addressed to fix the matter once and for all."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "In Genoa, #Juventus is heading toward confirming 9 or 10 of the 11 starters that played in Lecce, perhaps even the entire team.#Sarr does not have 90 minutes in his legs.#DouglasLuiz is forced to play, also because there are few alternatives in midfield.Without him, there would be a risk of losing even more balance.#Juve is not going to recover any players before the international break."[@romeoagresti via @PuebloJ]
.@sscnapoli, a two-match ban for Massimiliano #Allegri: barring any appeals, he will miss the matches against #Monza and #Juventus[Di Marzio]

📊 The numbers for #DouglasLuiz in #Juventus's 2-0 victory against #Lecce, following the handball against #Rennes in the Europa League that cost the penalty converted by #Dia:- 1 goal and 1 assist- 2 key passes and 1 big chance created, with 0.36 xA and 0.02 xG- 95 touches and 65 completed out of 79 (82%)- 33 accurate passes in his own half (89%) and 32 in the opponent's half (76%)- 50% on long balls (6/12)- 279.6 total meters of carrying distance, 31 carries and 9 defensive recoveries- 4 aerial duels won out of 4 and 2 ground duels won- 6 defensive contributions, including 4 clearances and 1 interception.[@junews24com via @PuebloJ]

✍️ "#Juventus is evaluating a contract extension for #DouglasLuiz (just as they previously did with Nico #González) to reduce the annual amortization on the financial balance sheet, valuing his growing prominence in the team."[@NicoSchira on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

📊 The numbers for Weston #McKennie, scorer of the first goal in #Juventus's 2-0 victory against #Lecce:- 1 goal with just 1 shot, with 0.59 xG and 0.88 xGOT- 57 touches and 26 completed passes out of 33 (79%)- 77% accuracy in the opponent's half (20/26) and 2/2 on long balls- 9 carries, 83.3 total carrying meters and 1 progressive carry- 3 defensive contributions (1 interception and 2 clearances) and 2 recoveries- 4 ground duels and 4 aerial duels, of which he won 2.[@junews24com via @PuebloJ]

🇧🇷 #DouglasLuiz, two records in #Lecce-#Juventus:📊 65 successful passes📊 16 successful passes in the final thirdNo player on the pitch did better in either statistic.⚪⚫ How do you evaluate his performance?[IlBianconero]

✅ The month of January will be very important for the future of Adin #Licina.‼️#Juventus will have to decide whether to keep him or sell him in the face of a big offer (they rejected one from #Napoli in the summer).⚪⚫ Today there is no hint of a sale, as the management considers #Licina a top-level player for the future #Juve. #Brighton, #Leipzig and other foreign clubs are showing interest.[Mirko Di Natale]

LUCIO CALLS #JUVE14 points and 7th placeHe beats #DiFra 2-0 without 9 players: "We won for those who have this club at heart".He conquers #Lecce and bites back: "We need to put more into it".#Mckennie and #DouglasLuiz seal the deal in 41 minutes. "A very serious first half, in the second we dropped deep". Wednesday night the test at Marassi.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#JUVE, AND #LUIZ IT WASDouglas is a protagonist again and together with #McKennie brings back the victory, reassuring #Spalletti and the fans.#Lecce was never scary, the bianconeri stuck to business, avoiding silly mistakes: #Woltemade and #Kolo didn't make an impact, but 6th place is reached again with #Frosinone that got a sensational 4-4 with #Atalanta. Lucio: "With the 3-5-2, we don't concede counterattacks anymore. Now I hope I can sleep. But if I think about the second half, I wake right up..."[Front Page TuttoSport]
